steps.title: Choose your own USA disc
steps.instruction: On first Play, choose your own MediEvil II USA SCUS-94564 CUE with its BIN tracks, or a supported CHD, in the native launcher. The disc remains required. This precompiled player includes OpenBIOS and needs no compiler, Python, Generate step or retail BIOS. Its first run prepares a verified resident loading cache.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, choose your own MediEvil II USA SCUS-94564 CUE with its BIN tracks, or a supported CHD, in the native launcher. The disc remains required. This precompiled player includes OpenBIOS and needs no compiler, Python, Generate step or retail BIOS. Its first run prepares a verified resident loading cache. Windows settings, remembered disc/BIOS paths, input bindings, saves/memory cards, diagnostics and installed mod packages are declared beside MediEvilIIRecomp.exe. Bundled mods stay version-owned; only installed/legacy user packages and their state/staging are retained. Resident decoded assets use the system user cache, outside Portcove backups. The selected external disc remains external. Use an external copy for custom BIOS preparation, cache-producing legacy mods or changed runtime files. Runtime rollback carries current declared data; it does not rewind saves or guarantee older save-state compatibility. Existing external installations keep their files and runtime owner. Gameplay, minimum environment and packaged Desktop acceptance remain separate observations.
